title_sq: Okazion Kleringu! Tek "Tirana New Entry", Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Strukture Perfekte !!
description_sq: Tek Kompleksi Tirana New Entry, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2 Me Planimetri Te Rregullt !! Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 94.9 m², ndodhet ne katin e 3 te njeres prej godinave te kompleksit. Organizohet ne sallonin e bollshem te ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit dhe dalje ne ballkon , dhome matrimoniale me tualet me vete, dhome femijesh dhe tualeti dites. Orientimi i apartamentit eshte Jug-Perendim. Vetem 15 minuta nga qendra e qytetit të Tiranes, pozicioni i “Tirana New Entry” favorizon komunitetin e saj me akses te drejtperdrejte ndaj sherbimeve si: shkolla, spitale, qendra tregtare, transport urban, etj., ne nje rreze te afert prej 1 km. Brenda kesaj rrezeje, ne afersi me kompleksin, ndodhen 5 objekte arsimore si: shkolla 9-vjeçare, të mesme, kolegje dhe universitete. Prane “New Entry Tirana” ndodhen 3 objekte te sherbimit shendetesor si: spital, poliklinike dhe qender shendetesore. Hapesira rekreative dhe te gjelberta shtrihen ne siperfaqe dhe ne lartesi, duke mundesuar nje nderlidhje midis banimit, sherbimeve dhe qarkullimit. Per kete projekt eshte konceptuar nje zone perimetrale e gjelberuar qe siguron: privatesi, komfort, ventilim natyror dhe siguri. Siperfaqe rekreative dhe gjelberim 35% e hapesires. Qendrueshmeri dhe jetegjatesi ne projektim. Projektimi i qendrueshem eshte nje nder pikat e forta te zhvillimit te ketij kompleksi, duke perdorur teknologji bashkekohore dhe standarde europiane me aplikimin e fasades dhe vetratave termike. Aktualisht, godina eshte ne faze fasade.
title_en: Clearing opportunity! At "Tirana New Entry", 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale, with Perfect Structures!!
description_en: At the Tirana New Entry Complex, 2+1+2 Apartment for Sale with Regular Layout!! The apartment with a total area of ​​94.9 m² is located on the 3rd floor of one of the buildings of the complex. It is organized in a spacious living room with a kitchenette and access to the balcony, a matrimonial room with its own toilet, a children's room and a day toilet. The orientation of the apartment is South-West. Only 15 minutes from the city center of Tirana, the position of "Tirana New Entry" favors its community with direct access to services such as: schools, hospitals, shopping centers, urban transport, etc., in a close radius of 1 km. Within this radius, in the vicinity of the complex, there are 5 educational facilities such as: 9-year schools, high schools, colleges and universities. Near "New Entry Tirana" there are 3 health service facilities such as: hospital, polyclinic and health center. Recreational and green spaces extend on the surface and in height, enabling a connection between housing, services and circulation. For this project, a green perimeter area has been conceived that ensures: privacy, comfort, natural ventilation and security. Recreational surface and greenery 35% of the space. Sustainability and longevity in design. The sustainable design is one of the strong points of the development of this complex, using contemporary technology and European standards with the application of the facade and thermal windows. Currently, the building is in the facade stage.
